factsFromPixels.description: One connected black-on-white electrical apparatus drawing. Left: a circular vacuum-tube symbol. Upper middle: a pair of coupled coils and a two-plate capacitor. Lower middle: a second pair of coils with a dark vertical core mark. Bottom left: a DC supply drawn with alternating unequal vertical plates. Right: a rectangular oscilloscope enclosure containing a circular dark screen. There are no three separately framed waveform plots.
factsFromPixels.mappingStatus: not authored because requested three-curve target conflicts with source

factsFromPixels.description: Circular enclosure at left with a short thick horizontal electrode near its top, a broken horizontal grid-like line across its middle, and curved electrode/filament strokes near its bottom. Two leads descend below the circular enclosure. A top wire rises from the upper electrode, runs right, and descends to the upper bus near the right coil. A middle wire runs from the tube toward the left coil. A lower connection reaches the lower left bus and DC branch. No visible written electrode names, numbers, voltages, or polarity signs are present.

Two adjacent coil strokes form the upper coupled-coil assembly. The left coil is connected between the tube-side middle and lower wiring. The right coil is connected between upper and lower horizontal buses. A vertical capacitor, drawn as two separated thick horizontal plates, bridges those same right-side buses. Filled junction dots are visible at bus/branch connections. The upper bus extends right and turns downward before reaching the upper oscilloscope terminal; the lower bus extends horizontally to the lower oscilloscope terminal.

A second coupled-coil assembly is below the upper bus assembly. A dark vertical core mark separates its two windings. The left winding's upper lead returns to the lower bus of the upper assembly; its lower lead joins the bottom DC-supply branch. The right winding has two rightward leads ending in oblique terminal marks. Between these leads there is a tilde followed by a U-like voltage label with a small suffix. The suffix is not transcribed as a definite English or mathematical value. The DC supply branch contains alternating short/thick and long/thin vertical plate strokes, with broken horizontal connection strokes between the cell symbols. No numerical supply value is printed.
factsFromPixels.mappingStatus: unmapped HOLD; exact small voltage-label suffix not resolved

factsFromPixels.description: Tall rectangular enclosure on the right with two terminal marks connected to the upper and lower circuit buses. Near its upper portion is one approximately circular dark screen with one light oscillatory trace. The trace has repeated rapid oscillations whose visible vertical extent varies across the screen. There is no displayed coordinate frame, time-axis label, vertical-axis label, scale, numerical tick, independently drawn envelope, zero marker, or endpoint value.
